RNAV ROUTES AND SEGMENTS AFFECTED DURING TEST FIRING AS FLW:

1- AWY N644 INB-KARDE SEGMENT CLSD.
ACFT THAT ARE GOING TO EXIT VIA ROLIN COULD FOLLOW 
MIMTO-DCT-CRM-DCT-ROLIN.
ACFT USING THIS ROUTE COULD FOLLOW VIA WESTBOUND FALAZ-DCT-CRM.
2- AWY M859 RERVA-KARDE SEGMENT CLSD.
ACFT THAT ARE GOING TO EXIT VIA ROLIN COULD FOLLOW 
UDROS-DCT-CRM-DCT-ROLIN. 
ACFT THAT ARE GOING TO EXIT VIA REBLO AND NOLGA COULD FOLLOW 
UDROS-DCT-CRM-M11-TBN.
3- AWY N743 GAKSU-ODIRA SEGMENT CLSD.
INSTEAD OF THIS ROUTE ALL ACFT COULD FOLLOW AWY G901 BALUM-CRM 
BIDIRECTIONALLY.
4- AWY M10 OLUPO-GOKPA SEGMENT CLSD.
INSTEAD OF THIS ROUTE ALL ACFT COULD FOLLOW SARPI-OLUPO-DCT-CRM.
5- AWY L851 KUGOS-KARDE SEGMENT CLSD.
6- AWY T310 SIN-GAKSU SEGMENT CLSD.

VERTICAL LIMITS: SFC-25000FT AMSL
